definitions: Monthly Recurring Revenue: The total predictable revenue that a company expects to receive every month from its subscriptions or services.
Material Removal Rate: The volume of material removed per unit of time in a machining or manufacturing process.
examples: Our SaaS company's MRR grew by 15% last quarter.
Optimizing the MRR is crucial for profitability in this grinding operation.
The investor was keen on the consistent MRR.
Higher MRR often indicates a more efficient process.
